notes.title: Cloud Saves have been enabled!
notes.content:
Steam Cloud saves have been enabled.  Your game and campaign state will be automatically copied to all your computers, so you can pick up where you left off on another machine. 

Note that your save state is tied to your player name, so if you changed your name from "Pharaoh," you may need to select your player name when you get to a new machine.   Click "(If this is not your name, click here)" and then choose your name from the list.
